question: The Nehru Trophy competition near Alappuzha, held on the second Saturday of August every year, is the most competitive and popular of the _________ category.
solution:
The correct answer is __**boat races**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Nehru Trophy competition near Alappuzha is the most competitive and popular of the **boat races** category.
 
• This event is held annually on the second Saturday of August.
 
• The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is named after India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• It is one of the premier snake boat races in Kerala, attracting numerous tourists and participants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Nehru Trophy Boat Race was first conducted in 1952 to commemorate the visit of Jawaharlal Nehru to Alappuzha.
 
• The race is conducted on the Punnamada Lake and is a major cultural event in Kerala.
 
• Snake boats, known as "Chundan Vallams," are used in this race, and they can accommodate over 100 rowers.
 
• The event is a symbol of Kerala's rich tradition and communal harmony.
